title: Moving Checklist
description: Anyone moving house: a timeline checklist, box inventory and address-change tracker.

spec.useCase: Gabriel Torres is moving across town and tracks every task, box and address change in one list.

Schedule internet at the new place
Forward mail with the post office
Update the address with the bank

text.text: Describe the task and who it involves.

text.text: List the main items so you can find the box without opening it.
Which room does it go to?
Weight: keep it under what one person can lift

text.text: Work left to right across the timeframes, label every box, and tell everyone your new address.
Pack room by room and label two sides of every box.
Heavy items in small boxes, light items in large boxes.
Fill gaps with towels so nothing shifts.
Mark fragile boxes on the top and sides.
Keep tape, scissors and markers in the last box.
Start with rooms you use least: garage, spare room, off-season closets.
Do the kitchen over two days; it always takes longer than planned.
Leave beds, toiletries and the essentials bag for the last evening.
Write the destination room, a two-word summary of the contents, and a number on two sides. Example: KITCHEN - pans and lids - 7.
Pack this last and carry it yourself.
Open the first-night box before anything else.
After a long day you will not want to dig for a charger or a kettle. One box, packed last and loaded last, makes the first evening calm.
Cash and a takeaway menu for dinner
Hand this timeline to whoever is helping on the day.

cells.text: Walk them through fragile boxes and the order of loading
Keep the first-night kit with you
Keys to the landlord, unload at the new place
Direct each box to its room by the label

text.text: Keep valuables, documents and medicines with you, not on the truck.
